protocol: MCTS-vs-MCTS; one checkpoint; paired seeds; swapped seats; deterministic max-visit selection; no root noise
interpretation: The full agent is compared separately with uniform-policy, zero-value, and combined ablations. Progressive widening is disabled by default so policy ablation does not also change which wall candidates are admitted. All agents still use PUCT MCTS. This measures component contribution under this search protocol, not absolute playing strength.
